metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code with entry points (index.cfm, download.cfm) present, deployed on a single Windows EC2 instance running IIS/ColdFusion 8 with SQL Server 2005. Classified as application.
metadata.archetype_justification: Database connections present (SQL Server via cfquery datasource), user session management, search and download operations with user-specific context (session.userid). No multi-service orchestration or event processing. Classified as stateful-crud.

findings.title: All compute on single raw EC2 instance with EOL OS/runtime
findings.description: All compute runs on a single raw EC2 instance (Windows Server 2008 with IIS 7 and Adobe ColdFusion 8). No managed container orchestration or serverless is in use.
findings.gap: Zero managed compute adoption. Single EC2 instance with EOL OS and runtime.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to managed compute (Lambda behind API Gateway or ECS Fargate). Replace ColdFusion runtime with a supported language first.

findings.title: Self-managed SQL Server 2005 — no managed database services
findings.description: SQL Server 2005 is self-managed on EC2. No AWS managed database services (RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB) are in use.
findings.gap: All databases self-managed. SQL Server 2005 is 9+ years past EOL.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to RDS PostgreSQL or Aurora PostgreSQL using AWS DMS.

findings.title: No workflow orchestration infrastructure
findings.description: No workflow orchestration services are in use. All logic is inline in CFM files with no orchestration capability.
findings.gap: No orchestration infrastructure exists for any multi-step processes.
findings.recommendation: Consider Step Functions for any multi-step workflows when modernizing.

findings.title: No messaging or streaming — all synchronous
findings.description: No messaging or streaming infrastructure exists. All operations are synchronous HTTP. No SQS, SNS, EventBridge, or message broker.
findings.gap: No messaging where state changes could benefit from decoupling.
findings.recommendation: Adopt EventBridge or SNS for event-driven patterns when modernizing.

findings.title: No VPC, network segmentation, or HTTPS
findings.description: No VPC, subnet, or security group configuration defined. Application runs HTTP-only on internal network with no network segmentation.
findings.gap: No VPC, private subnets, security groups, or network segmentation. HTTP-only.
findings.recommendation: Deploy in VPC with private subnets, security groups, and HTTPS via ALB or API Gateway.

findings.title: No API gateway or load balancer — direct IIS exposure
findings.description: No API Gateway, ALB, CloudFront, or managed entry point. ColdFusion served directly by IIS with no throttling, auth, or request validation at entry.
findings.gap: Services exposed directly with no gateway or load balancer.
findings.recommendation: Add API Gateway or ALB as entry point with throttling, auth, and WAF integration.

findings.title: No auto-scaling — single static instance
findings.description: No auto-scaling configuration. Single static EC2 instance with zero horizontal scaling capability.
findings.gap: All capacity statically provisioned with no auto-scaling for any resource type.
findings.recommendation: Configure auto-scaling when migrating to managed compute (ECS target-tracking, Lambda concurrency).

findings.title: No backups — disk loss equals data loss
findings.description: No backup configuration. README states 'no backups offsite' and 'disk loss = data loss.' Files on local disk with no replication.
findings.gap: Zero backup infrastructure. No automated backups, no retention, no PITR, no restore procedures.
findings.recommendation: Implement RDS automated backups with PITR, S3 versioning for documents, AWS Backup plan.

findings.title: Single point of failure — no multi-AZ, no redundancy
findings.description: All resources in single instance. Reboot equals downtime. No multi-AZ, no failover, no load balancing.
findings.gap: Single point of failure with no multi-AZ, no redundancy, no automatic failover.
findings.recommendation: Deploy across 2+ AZs with ALB, ECS multi-AZ task placement, and RDS Multi-AZ.

findings.title: Zero Infrastructure as Code — all manual ClickOps
findings.description: No IaC files exist. No Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, or any IaC. All infrastructure manually created.
findings.gap: 0% IaC coverage. All infrastructure is ClickOps with no reproducibility.
findings.recommendation: Define all infrastructure in CDK or Terraform. This is prerequisite for all other modernization.

findings.title: Zero CI/CD — manual file copy deployment
findings.description: No CI/CD automation. Deployment is manual file copy over network share. No pipeline, no build step, no testing.
findings.gap: Zero automation. Manual deployment with no quality gates or rollback.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with CodePipeline + CodeBuild including build, test, security scan, and deploy stages.

findings.title: ColdFusion 8 — EOL language with no AWS SDK or cloud-native tooling
findings.description: CFML on Adobe ColdFusion 8 (unsupported, multiple critical CVEs). No AWS SDK, no cloud-native tooling, extremely limited ecosystem.
findings.gap: Language with no AWS SDK and no cloud-native tooling. Runtime EOL and unsupported.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite in modern cloud-native language (Python 3.12+, Node.js 20+, or Java 21+ with Spring Boot 3.x).

findings.title: Tightly-coupled monolith — no module boundaries
findings.description: Tightly-coupled monolith. UI, business logic, and data access interleaved in 2 CFM files with no separation of concerns.
findings.gap: No module boundaries. Cannot scale, deploy, or modify any concern independently.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite with clean architecture: separate API, service, and data access layers.

findings.title: All communication synchronous — no async patterns
findings.description: All communication is synchronous HTTP with no async patterns. Zero async capability for state propagation.
findings.gap: All communication synchronous with no event-driven capability.
findings.recommendation: Adopt EventBridge for domain events and SQS for background processing when modernizing.

findings.title: All operations synchronous regardless of duration
findings.description: All operations synchronous. File downloads served synchronously from local disk. No async job processing or status polling.
findings.gap: No async job infrastructure for potentially long-running operations.
findings.recommendation: Use S3 presigned URLs for downloads. Use SQS + Lambda or Step Functions for batch operations.

findings.title: No API versioning strategy
findings.description: No API versioning. Endpoints are static filenames (index.cfm, download.cfm) with no version prefix or headers.
findings.gap: No versioning — any changes break all consumers immediately.
findings.recommendation: Adopt URL-path versioning (/v1/documents) with API Gateway and OpenAPI spec.

findings.title: All endpoints hard-coded — no service discovery
findings.description: All service endpoints hard-coded. Database datasource in CF Admin, file path hard-coded in source. No service registry or discovery.
findings.gap: All endpoints hard-coded with no dynamic discovery mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Use environment variables (12-factor). For multi-service, adopt AWS Cloud Map.

findings.title: Documents stored on local filesystem — no object storage
findings.description: Documents stored on local disk at D:\docroot\files. No S3, no object storage, no parsing pipeline, no accessibility beyond single server.
findings.gap: Unstructured data locked on local filesystem with no durability or accessibility.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to S3 with presigned URLs, versioning, lifecycle policies, and Textract for parsing.

findings.title: Inline SQL scattered across files — no data access layer
findings.description: SQL queries scattered inline in CFM files using cfquery tags with string concatenation. No repository pattern, no ORM, no centralized data access.
findings.gap: Database queries scattered with no pattern. SQL injection vulnerable.
findings.recommendation: Implement repository/DAO pattern with parameterized queries or ORM.

findings.title: SQL Server 2005 — 9+ years past EOL
findings.description: SQL Server 2005 reached EOL April 2016. Over 9 years past end-of-life. No version pinning in IaC (no IaC exists).
findings.gap: Database engine 9+ years past EOL with no security patches or vendor support.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to RDS PostgreSQL 16 or Aurora PostgreSQL using AWS DMS.

findings.title: Zero encryption at rest — files and database unencrypted
findings.description: No encryption at rest. Documents on local disk unencrypted. SQL Server 2005 has no TDE. No KMS configuration.
findings.gap: All data stored unencrypted — documents and database.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to S3 with SSE-KMS and RDS with KMS encryption. Use customer-managed keys.

findings.title: Session-based auth only — no OAuth2/JWT, download endpoint unprotected
findings.description: Session-based auth on index.cfm but download.cfm has no auth check. No token-based auth (OAuth2/JWT). Session fixation vulnerability.
findings.gap: No token-based auth. Download endpoint completely unauthenticated. Session fixation possible.
findings.recommendation: Implement Cognito + JWT on all endpoints. Add auth to download.cfm. Enable HTTPS.

findings.title: Application-managed auth with no centralized IdP or SSO
findings.description: Application manages own authentication with no external IdP. No Cognito, no OIDC/SAML, no SSO, no federation.
findings.gap: No centralized IdP integration. No SSO. Standalone authentication.
findings.recommendation: Integrate with Cognito or corporate IdP (Okta/Azure AD) via OIDC. Enable SSO.

findings.title: Plaintext credentials in README — critical secret exposure
findings.description: Database password ('cfadmin') documented in README in plaintext. Credentials version-controlled with no secrets management or rotation.
findings.gap: Plaintext credentials in version control. No secrets management, no rotation, no audit.
findings.recommendation: Remove credentials from README. Store all secrets in AWS Secrets Manager with automated rotation.

findings.title: EOL compute with critical CVEs — no patching strategy
findings.description: Windows Server 2008 (EOL) and ColdFusion 8 (unsupported, critical CVEs). No patching, no vulnerability scanning, no hardening.
findings.gap: All compute running EOL software with known critical vulnerabilities. No patching.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to managed services (Fargate/Lambda) or use SSM Patch Manager with Amazon Inspector.

findings.title: No security scanning — known vulnerabilities undetected
findings.description: No SAST, DAST, or dependency scanning. No CI/CD pipeline to integrate scanning. Known SQL injection and path traversal exist undetected.
findings.gap: Zero security scanning despite known critical vulnerabilities in the code.
findings.recommendation: Integrate SAST (Semgrep), dependency scanning (Dependabot), and container scanning in CI/CD.

findings.title: No distributed tracing
findings.description: No tracing instrumented. No X-Ray, no OpenTelemetry. ColdFusion 8 has no tracing support.
findings.gap: Zero tracing capability. Cannot trace requests or diagnose performance issues.
findings.recommendation: Instrument with AWS X-Ray or OpenTelemetry when modernizing to supported language.

findings.title: No SLOs defined
findings.description: No SLOs, no monitoring artifacts, no CloudWatch alarms, no latency/error-rate tracking.
findings.gap: No SLOs — no formal service level definitions or monitoring.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs (availability, latency, error rate) with CloudWatch alarms and dashboards.

findings.title: No business metrics published
findings.description: No custom metrics. No business outcome tracking (documents downloaded, searches performed).
findings.gap: No custom metrics or business outcome measurement.
findings.recommendation: Publish custom CloudWatch metrics for business events. Create dashboards.

findings.title: No alerting or anomaly detection
findings.description: No alerting configured. No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection. Service failure discovered by user complaint only.
findings.gap: Zero alerting — no threshold alarms, no anomaly detection, no notifications.
findings.recommendation: Configure CloudWatch alarms on error rates, latency, 5xx responses. Enable anomaly detection.

findings.title: Direct-to-production file copy — no deployment strategy
findings.description: Deployment is manual file copy to wwwroot. No staged rollout, no canary, no blue/green, no health checks, no rollback.
findings.gap: Direct-to-production with no safety net or rollback capability.
findings.recommendation: Implement blue/green via CodeDeploy or ECS rolling updates with health checks and rollback.

findings.title: Zero automated tests
findings.description: No tests of any kind. No unit tests, no integration tests, no test framework. Changes deployed with zero validation.
findings.gap: Zero automated testing. No regression detection, no safety net for changes.
findings.recommendation: Establish integration tests for critical workflows. Run in CI pipeline before every deployment.

findings.title: No incident response automation or runbooks
findings.description: No runbooks, no SSM Automation, no self-healing. Incident response entirely ad hoc.
findings.gap: No runbooks, no automated remediation, no incident procedures.
findings.recommendation: Create runbooks and SSM Automation for common scenarios (restart, failover, disk alerts).

findings.title: No observability ownership
findings.description: No dashboards, no alarms with owners, no monitoring ownership. Zero observability infrastructure.
findings.gap: No observability ownership — service health is invisible.
findings.recommendation: Establish per-service dashboards, assign alarm owners, define CODEOWNERS for monitoring.

pathways.name: Move to Containers
pathways.key_trigger_criteria: INF-Q1=1 (<3) AND no container definitions found in repository

detail.current_state: Single Windows Server 2008 EC2 instance with IIS/ColdFusion 8. No Dockerfiles or container definitions.
immediate_actions: Rewrite in containerizable language (ColdFusion 8 has no Docker support)

pathways.name: Move to Open Source
pathways.key_trigger_criteria: DATA-Q4=4 (no stored procedures — threshold <3 not met). While SQL Server (commercial) is detected, DATA-Q4 does not meet the primary trigger threshold.

triggering_questions.note: DATA-Q4=4 meets threshold; no stored procedure coupling to commercial engine

pathways.not_triggered_reason: DATA-Q4 scored 4 (no stored procedures or proprietary SQL). The primary trigger requires DATA-Q4 < 3 to indicate coupling to commercial database engines. This application uses only ANSI-standard SQL, so migration to open-source is straightforward via the Managed Databases pathway without needing a dedicated open-source migration effort.

pathways.name: Move to Managed Databases
pathways.key_trigger_criteria: INF-Q2=1 (<3) — self-managed SQL Server 2005 on EC2. Supported by DATA-Q3=1 (<3) — engine 9+ years past EOL.

detail.current_state: Self-managed SQL Server 2005 on EC2/on-premises. EOL since April 2016. Simple schema (documents table).
immediate_actions: Plan database migration to RDS PostgreSQL or Aurora

pathways.name: Move to Managed Analytics
pathways.key_trigger_criteria: No data processing workloads exist. This is a simple CRUD document portal with no streaming, ETL, or analytics.

triggering_questions.note: INF-Q4=1 but contextual guard blocks: no data processing workloads in this CRUD portal

pathways.not_triggered_reason: Contextual guard: no evidence of data processing workloads (no streaming, ETL, data pipelines, or analytics artifacts found). This is a simple document search/download portal.

pathways.name: Move to Modern DevOps
pathways.key_trigger_criteria: INF-Q10=1 (<3) AND INF-Q11=1 (<3). Supported by OPS-Q5=1, OPS-Q6=1.

detail.current_state: Zero IaC, zero CI/CD. Manual file copy deployment. No tests. No deployment strategy.

pathways.name: Move to AI
pathways.key_trigger_criteria: No AI/agent intent evidenced in the repository (no AI-related signal terms in dependencies, source, configuration, IaC, or documentation).
pathways.not_triggered_reason: No AI/agent intent evidenced in the repository. No AI-related signal terms found in any repository artifacts.

decomposition_strategy.rationale: Application is tiny (2 files, ~60 lines), runtime is EOL (ColdFusion 8), database is EOL (SQL Server 2005), and critical security vulnerabilities exist. Incremental extraction is not viable for a 2-file application.
decomposition_strategy.effort_estimate: Low for rewrite (1-2 weeks), Medium for surrounding infrastructure (4-8 weeks)
